description: Normalisation rules applied by Agent 3 after raw extraction. All rules are deterministic — no inference allowed.

T1.description: MCI vs Healthy Controls — current state binary classification

T2.description: Progressive vs Stable MCI — conversion prediction

T3.description: Multi-class staging — HC/EMCI/LMCI/AD four-class or three-class

T4.description: Subtype, biomarker, correlational, or other non-standard task
T4.use_when: Task does not cleanly fit T1, T2, T3, T5, or T6

T5.description: MCI reversion — predicting return to normal cognition

T6.use_when: Paper does not build or evaluate a classifier

V1.criteria: Paper explicitly states leave-one-out cross-validation AND total N < 100
V1.note: LOOCV on large N is V2 not V1

V2.description: k-fold CV on same dataset, no separate held-out test set
V2.criteria: k-fold without a held-out test set; or train/val split without external site; or absence of reporting
V2.note: Default when validation protocol is ambiguous

V3.description: k-fold + separate held-out test partition from same dataset
V3.criteria: Explicit 70/30, 80/20, or similar train/test split; OR nested CV with inner/outer loops; same institution
V3.note: Stratified split = V3 if split is at subject level (not sample level)

V4.description: External validation — different institution or country
V4.criteria: Paper explicitly reports testing on a cohort collected at a different institution OR different country from training data
examples: trained on ADNI, tested on NACC
trained on Chinese cohort, tested on European cohort
V4.note: Multi-phase ADNI (train ADNI-2, test ADNI-3) is V3 not V4 — same institution

accuracy_flags.flag_message: Raw accuracy suspect: majority class exceeds 70% of N. Flag for imbalance review.
accuracy_flags.action: Set Best_Metric prefix to 'Acc*' where * indicates suspect; note in extraction log

metric_normalisation.note: When multiple metrics reported, prefer AUC for imbalanced tasks (T2), prefer Acc for balanced tasks (T3)

architecture_family_rules.note: A7 only if NLP is the PRIMARY method, not just used for preprocessing. Ensemble (A6) only if combining methods from 2+ different families.

not_reported_handling.Best_Metric: Set to 'NR'. Do not compute from other metrics.
not_reported_handling.Best_AUC: Set to 'NR'. Do not compute from sensitivity/specificity.
not_reported_handling.Sample_N_Approx: Set to 'NR'. Do not estimate from text description.
not_reported_handling.XAI_Method: Set to 'none'. Paper with no explainability = none, not NR.
not_reported_handling.class_balance_unknown: Flag Best_Metric with 'Acc?' prefix when class balance not reported and raw accuracy is the metric
not_reported_handling.general_rule: NR is always preferable to a guess. Downstream agents treat NR as absent evidence, not as zero.

extensions_documentation.serum_biomarkers: blood-serum protein/assay studies (no detector serum branch exists)
extensions_documentation.blood_metabolomics: NMR/LC-MS metabolomics or lipidomics panels on blood/serum/plasma
extensions_documentation.PET_plus_CSF: PET imaging combined with CSF biomarkers (no MRI)
extensions_documentation.review_no_primary_data: reviews, perspectives, bibliometrics, consensus papers without pooled classifier data
extensions_documentation.meta_analysis_pooled: quantitative pooled synthesis; modality inherited from pooled studies where single
extensions_documentation.population_cohort_epidemiology: population/cohort epidemiological association studies without a device modality
extensions_documentation.psychophysics: laboratory psychophysical paradigms (sensory thresholds, TVA etc.)
extensions_documentation.gastrointestinal_EGEG: electrogastroenterography visceral myoelectrical activity (P-1354; no detector branch)
extensions_documentation.nomogram_clinical_scores: nomograms/risk scores built on clinical+lab variables (no device modality)
extensions_documentation.urine_metabolomics: urine LC-MS/MS or NMR metabolomics studies (P-1402; distinct biofluid from blood_metabolomics so bucket gate must not pair them)
extensions_documentation.serum_glycomics: Added 2026-09-05 (batch P-1413..P-1422, PAPERINGO-r850): released N-glycan profiling of serum by C18/MGC LC-MS/MS with PRM validation (P-1417 Onigbinde et al., J Proteome Res). Distinct from proteomics (glycan structures, not proteins) and blood_metabolomics (glycoconjugate class).
